sections.content:
All 8 RIGHTs executed, no block. White foot is now at cols 38-40 (rows 14-16 and 20-22). Green foot is at cols 38-40, rows 35-37 and 41-43. The white piece's body is currently at cols 41-55, rows 11-25 — the D is at rows 29-49, so no overlap yet.
Next, need 7 DOWNs to bring the foot to rows 35-37/41-43. But as I move down, the white body (rows 11-25 → moving down) will eventually overlap the D (rows 29-49, cols 41-49). The white body occupies cols 41-55. After 1 DOWN: body rows 12-26. After 2: 13-27... After 4 DOWNs: body rows 15-29 → row 29 touches the top row of the D (cols 41-49: the D's top bar is rows 29-31, full width cols 41-49). The white body at rows 15-29: which cols? The body's shape: right vertical bar col 55 (rows 15-29), arms at rows 18-20 and 24-26 (cols 41-49), top bar rows 15-17 cols 47-53.
After 4 DOWNs: the body's bottom row 29 = the D's top row 29 (cols 41-49). The white body's row 29 = bottom bar rows 24-26 → after 4 DOWNs rows 28-30? Wait, let me recalculate.
Current white body (before DOWN): rows 11-25:
- Rows 11-13: cols 47-53 (top bar)
- Rows 14-16: cols 41-49 (arm 1)
- Rows 17-19: col 53 (stem)
- Rows 20-22: cols 41-49 (arm 2)
- Rows 23-25: cols 47-53 (bottom bar)
After k DOWNs, add k to the rows.
The D occupies rows 29-49, cols 41-49, with a hole at rows 32-46, cols 44-46.
Overlap check per k:
k=1: body rows 12-26. Max row 26 < 29. No overlap.
k=2: rows 13-27. No overlap.
k=3: rows 14-28. No overlap (28 < 29).
k=4: rows 15-29. Row 29: the body's row 29 = bottom bar (rows 23-25+4=27-29) cols 47-53. The D's row 29: cols 41-49. Overlap at cols 47-49! So if overlap is forbidden, k=4 will be blocked.
Hmm. So if overlap is forbidden, I can only move down 3 times, and the foot will be at rows 17-19/23-25, not at the target.
But wait — maybe overlap is allowed (the piece can pass through the D). The 8 RIGHTs passed through... actually, during the RIGHTs, did the white body ever overlap the D? The body's right edge is col 55, the D's left is col 41: during the RIGHTs, the body's cols went from 17-29 to 41-55; the D is at rows 29-49, the body at rows 11-25 — no row overlap, so no test of overlap.
So the DOWNs will be the test. If k=4 is blocked, the goal isn't simple foot overlap... or maybe the game allows overlap and the foot just needs to coincide.
Let me try 7 DOWNs and see what happens. If it stops early, I'll know overlap is forbidden and I'll need to rethink (maybe the goal is to fit the white piece's arms into the D's hole? The hole is 3 wide, no... or maybe the goal is to make the white foot touch the green foot (adjacent)?).
Actually, let me think about what the "correct" final state might be. The D's hole is 3 wide × 15 tall. The white piece's... in the current orientation, the white piece's "gap" between the arms is 3 tall × 12 wide (rows 17-19, cols 41-52). Hmm.
What if I rotate the white piece 180° (two more SPACEs)? Then the foot would be on the right side, a vertical pair. The D's hole is 3 wide. The white piece's stem (1-wide col 53?)...
Alternatively, the intended solution might be: the white piece's arms go inside the D's hole? The hole is 3 wide — the arms are 9 wide. No.
What if the goal is to make the white foot coincide with the green foot, and overlap is allowed? Let me test with 7 DOWNs.
